arguments.argument: One row per calendar month: points earned, redeemed and expired (ordo_loyalty_points_ledger, see docs/adr/0044), the net change, and a running "Outstanding Liability" total - the latest month's value is the real, current, store-wide unredeemed/unexpired point balance across every customer right now. Redemption Rate is redeemed ÷ earned for that month only, blank when nothing was earned that month at all.
